## What We Do
- Google Business Profile optimization
- Local citation building (40–80+ directories depending on plan)
- On-page SEO and technical SEO audits
- Local keyword research and content strategy
- Backlink building
- Review generation and reputation management
- Weekly or bi-weekly ranking reports

## Who We Serve
Local service businesses in Palm Coast, Flagler Beach, Bunnell, and Flagler County, FL. Plumbers, HVAC contractors, roofers, landscapers, pest control, dentists, lawyers, restaurants, and any business where customers search on Google Maps.

See [Pricing](https://www.tdlocalseo.com/#pricing) for full plan details.

- Growth: $1,000/month — citations (60+ directories), full website SEO, premium backlinks, money-back guarantee
- Pro: $1,500/month — citations (80+ directories), review management, weekly reports, full money-back guarantee if not in the Google Maps Top 3 within 90 days
